title: Chapter 102 My Father Zhang Erhe
content:
Chapter 102 My Father Zhang Erhe

Awei looked gloomy and walked towards Zhang Guangyao with great strides.

laugh!

A long sword directly crossed Zhang Guangyao's neck. As long as Awei put a little force, his body would be separated directly.

"You you!"

At this moment, Zhang Guangyao was a little scared.

The other party actually didn't even care about his identity and wanted to kill him directly.

Seeing that the person in front of him was real, Zhang Guangyao did not dare to be careless and quickly shouted: "My father Zhang Erhe!"

Zhang Erhe? !

When everyone around heard this, they looked frightened.

That is the head of the Zhang family, one of the three top families in the inner city of Huangcheng!

It is rumored that the Zhang family was the elder at the beginning of the establishment of the deserted city and one of the few indigenous people of the deserted city.

A super family with the skill of the dragon.

This person turned out to be the son of Zhang Erhe, the Zhang family.

No wonder he is so arrogant.

Hearing this, the expressions of Huangwei around him were slightly moved.

Then he looked at their leader.

If it were them, they might have to turn a blind eye, but now the leader is here.

I wonder what the leader will do.

Awei also frowned slightly.

Seeing this scene, Zhang Guangyao thought Awei was scared and immediately breathed a sigh of relief.

Looking at the entire wasteland city, my father's name is absolutely useful.

However, the next moment, Zhang Guangyao was stunned again.

"Take all of you, take them away!"

Awei spoke coldly.

Then he looked at Zhang Guangyao.

After being stared at by such an extremely cold gaze, Zhang Guangyao couldn't help but tremble all over.

"Home, my father Zhang Erhe...."

"take away!"

"Home, my father Zhang Erhe!"

As the sound became smaller and smaller, Zhang Guangyao was taken away by Huang Wei without any surprise.

The ending can be imagined, it must be an advanced prison to enjoy it.

Scandal to the audience.

It was already a mess here at this moment.

Awei shook his head and was about to leave.

At this time, a Huangwei led a woman to Awei.

"Sir, there is a fallen girl from the elf tribe here, and she seems to have been trafficked here."

Upon hearing this, Awei turned his head and looked.

I saw a girl who seemed to be only sixteen years old was looking at him timidly, so watery that people couldn't help but want to step forward.

"I, I didn't gamble."

The elf girl said tremblingly.

Looking at the petite elf woman in front of her, Awei suddenly felt a little rippling in his heart for some reason.

Feeling the strange movement in his heart, Awei quickly shook his head.

After checking forward for any injuries, Awei whispered, "Where is your home, I'll take you back."

On the side, looking at the gentle side of his leader, several guards were stunned.

This was the first time they had seen the leader treat others so gentlely.

When the woman heard Awei's words, she lowered her head.

"I, I don't have a home."

orphan.

Upon hearing this, Awei stopped.

"Then, then where do you have any more places to go?"

The woman shook her head.

"What's the name?"

"My name is Fan Yingying."

Fan Yingying lowered her head tightly and whispered.

She was very confused at this time.

I lost my home and I was deceived into such a place again. Fortunately, I was rescued before I lost my virginity.

But what should I do after that?

Looking at the pitiful Fan Yingying in front of him, Awei made a major decision.

"Or, you go with me?"

Hearing this, Fan Yingying was stunned.

She had just heard this sentence not long ago, and was brought here.

I wanted to refuse, but when she looked up at Awei's sincere gaze, she hesitated.

"Don't be afraid of little girl, my leader is not a bad person."

At this time, the Huangwei beside him spoke.

Awei glanced at his subordinates with appreciation, and then stretched out his hand towards Fan Yingying.

"Yeah, OK."

After fighting for the inner thoughts, Fan Yingying finally agreed.

Holding Fan Yingying's tender little hand, for some reason, Awei's heart suddenly became a little beat faster.

Walk out of the casino and come outside.

The sun was dazzling, but Awei felt particularly happy.

Turning his head and looking at Fan Yingying, who was hiding behind him because of the dazzling sunshine, Awei couldn't help but raise his lips slightly.

"Sir, what should we do with those people?"

A guard of the desert stepped forward and asked.

Upon hearing this, Awei said indifferently: "According to the rules, what should be done?"

"What about that father Zhang Erhe?"

Awei was slightly stunned, silent for a moment, and still said, "What should I do?"

"Yes, Lord Chief."

......

"I, I don't know what your name is yet?"

Walking on the way back, Fan Yingying raised her little head and spoke timidly.

"My name is Awei, just call me brother."

Awei smiled.

In this way, the two of them returned to the Xuanling Star Domain Desert City through the time and space tunnel.

On the other side.

In the mansion of the head of the Zhang family.

The Xuanling Star Domain Desert City will naturally have a place for the Zhang family.

Not long after the time and space tunnel was opened, the Zhang family had completed the migration of some families.

The other part stayed in the deserted city of Wanlingjie.

"What! Guangyao was captured by the desert guards!"

Zhang Erhe, the head of the Zhang family, said with a look of shock and anger.

A servant stood beside Zhang Erhe and said in a trembling voice: "Head, Master Guangyao seems to have committed a crime and alarmed the leader of the desert guards."

Hearing this, Zhang Erhe took a breath of cold air and slumped in the chair with a pale face.

The leader of the desert guards!

Isn't that Awei?

As a native of the deserted city, he naturally knew about Awei.

Although he was still young at that time, he also knew what kind of person Awei was.

He was upright, especially loyal to the city lord, and there was nothing to say.

If his son committed a crime, Awei would never show mercy because of his feelings.

What's more, he had no feelings to talk about with Awei.

His father was almost the same.

By the way, Dad!

Zhang Erhe stood up suddenly and hurried to the depths of the Zhang family mansion.

"Master, your father is in seclusion. If you have anything to say, wait until your father comes out of seclusion."

As soon as he arrived at his father's door, he was turned away.

Zhang Erhe looked a little ugly.

If this continues, he will lose his son.

Although Zhang Guangyao is not his only son, he is also his own son. He has no reason to watch his son die like this.

The prison is not a place for his son to stay.

Lord City Lord!

Zhang Erhe knew that the only one who could save his son now was probably the Lord City Lord.

I hope the Lord City Lord can still remember the old friendship of our Zhang family.

Zhang Erhe thought so in his heart, and hurried to the City Lord's Mansion without stopping.

"Hey, Brother Zhang, you are so anxious, what are you going to do?"

Just after walking a few steps, he saw the current head of the Li family coming out for a walk.

At this moment, Li Gengnian, the head of the Li family, was beaming with joy and high spirits.

As one of the three top families in Huangcheng, the resources enjoyed by the Li family were naturally among the best in Huangcheng.

There were many masters in the family.

As the head of the family, he basically had no worries.

In fact, Zhang Erhe was the same.

It was a pity that his son was in trouble now.
